museum_text.zh: 作於一○七二年的〈早春圖〉，不僅是郭熙傳世的代表作，也是山水畫史中最重要的里程碑。郭熙在宋神宗時進入宮廷服務，正當王安石變法之際，官府殿閣的新建布置中，都使用了郭熙的山水。此作可能原來也是其中之一。 畫中構圖有著對稱性的安排，但在秩序感中又充滿著韻律的變化。而藉著墨色深淺所營造出來的光影效果，更為此山水增添了空間的奇幻。舟樵行旅等活動的加入，也進一步將此意境轉化成一個生機處處，可遊可居的神奇所在。這些表現都可以從他的《林泉高致》書中，得到理論上的印證。
museum_text.en: Kuo Hsi (active late 11th century) came from Wen-hsien, Honan. He was a student (i-hsueh) in the Painting Academy, specializing in landscapes and wintry trees. He was extremely skilful and profoundly original, and although he studied the style of Li Ch’eng he was also able to express his own feelings. On a large screen or high wall he would paint tall pines and large trees, winding streams and jagged promontories, lofty peaks and soaring cliffs, or high mountains gracefully rising, transformed or obliterated by mist and clouds and partially visible among them – he could render a thousand forms and myriad appearances. His mountain peaks were high and precipitous, his trees characterized by “crab-claw” branches, and his ink fairly dilute; his brushwork resembled that of cursive calligraphy, In his early years he concentrated on developing his skill, while in his later year his brushwork became increasingly strong. He wrote the Treatise on Landscape Painting (Shan-shui hua-lun) in which he said that one should study the near and far, the shallow and deep, the effects of wind and rain, light and shadow, and the changes of the seasons and times of day.

intro.zh: 郭熙在宋神宗时进入宫廷，当时新建的官府殿阁里都布置了他的山水；馆方推测此画原本也可能是其中之一。
intro.en: Guo Xi entered court service under Emperor Shenzong, when his landscapes decorated newly built government halls; the museum suggests Early Spring may once have been one of them.

intro.zh: 此画作于1072年，被视为中国山水画史上最重要的里程碑之一。
intro.en: Dated 1072, it is considered one of the great masterpieces of Chinese landscape painting.

intro.zh: 构图对称而有秩序，又充满韵律的变化；墨色的深浅营造出光影。
intro.en: The composition is symmetrical and ordered, yet full of rhythmic change, and graded ink creates light and shadow.

intro.zh: 他的画论《林泉高致》主张，画家要研究远近、浅深、风雨明晦以及四时朝暮的变化。
intro.en: His treatise, Lofty Message of Forests and Streams (林泉高致), says a painter should study near and far, shallow and deep, wind and rain, and the changes of the seasons and the times of day.

look_for.zh: 像蟹爪一样的枝梢，这是郭熙画树的特点。
look_for.en: Branches with claw-like tips: the museum notes his trees are known for their 'crab-claw' branches.

look_for.zh: 山水间的行舟、樵夫和旅人，让这里成为“可游可居”的地方。
look_for.en: Boats, woodcutters and travellers, which make this a place one could wander in and live in.

look_for.zh: 几种不同的树：弯曲的小树、盘曲的老树和挺直的高树。
look_for.en: Different kinds of trees: small bending ones, crouching gnarled ones and tall vertical ones.

look_for.zh: 没有单一的视点：郭熙认为看山水不必只从一处看。
look_for.en: No single viewpoint: Guo Xi held that a landscape need not be seen from one spot.

alt.zh: 一幅立轴山水，墨色褐灰：扭动的山峰穿过雾气升起，近景有光秃的树和岩石。
alt.en: A hanging scroll of a mountain landscape in grey-brown ink: twisting peaks rising through mist, with bare trees and rocks in the foreground.

about.zh: 据亚瑟·韦利（Arthur Waley）的英译

views.zh: 他记下父亲作画前的习惯：要先坐到一张干净的桌前。
views.en: He recorded his father's habits before painting, beginning with sitting down at a clean table.

quote.en: On days when he was going to paint, he would seat himself at a clean table

uw.title: Guo Xi's Early Spring (A Visual Sourcebook of Chinese Civilization)
